FIND_PACKAGE(jsoncpp CONFIG REQUIRED)
FIND_PACKAGE(CURL CONFIG REQUIRED)
FIND_PACKAGE(SQLite3 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(ixwebsocket REQUIRED)

TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(${PROJECT_NAME}_static JsonCpp::JsonCpp)
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(${PROJECT_NAME}_static CURL::libcurl)
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(${PROJECT_NAME}_static SQLite::SQLite3)
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(${PROJECT_NAME}_static ixwebsocket::ixwebsocket)
